## GPU profile of the final configuration (A7.2-A7.4, A7.7)

- Tesla T4, torch 2.11.0+cu130: train step 116.3 ms (550 img/s); GPU busy 137.0 ms/step, **idle 0.4 %**; 351 kernels/step (mean 388 us).
- Host-to-device per step: d2d 0.08 MiB in 0.007 ms.

| GPU kernel category | ms / step | share |
|---|---|---|
| conv (cuDNN) | 67.83 | 49.9 % |
| batch norm | 25.27 | 18.6 % |

| pooling | 16.96 | 12.5 % |
| optimizer (AdamW) | 1.95 | 1.4 % |
| AMP scaler | 0.46 | 0.3 % |
| data (index/gather, preprocess) | 0.38 | 0.3 % |
| reduction / loss | 0.06 | 0.0 % |
| gemm (fc) | 0.01 | 0.0 % |

| Phase (synchronized) | ms / step | share |
|---|---|---|
| data | 0.76 | 0.6 % |
| forward | 42.86 | 35.6 % |
| backward | 74.09 | 61.6 % |
| optimizer | 2.58 | 2.1 % |

Epoch decomposition: train 3.76 s (32 steps) + validation 0.31 s = 4.07 s (validation 8 %).

## Amdahl analysis

- Main optimization, decoded-image cache: p = 0.654 of the baseline epoch, stage speedup s = 1807x -> S = 1 / ((1 - p) + p / s) = **2.89x** (bound 1 / (1 - p) = 2.89x). A huge stage speedup buys less than 3x because 35 % of the epoch is untouched.
- All measured stages at their isolated speedups (loading 1807x, preprocessing 17.3x, training step 27.6x, 'other' 5.3 % unchanged): generalized Amdahl S = 1 / sum(p_i / s_i) = **15.5x**.
- Measured, same model, same Colab machine: 135x per steady epoch (`optimized_cnn` vs `exp_cache_cpu`). The prediction uses laptop-CPU fractions and speedups; on Colab the CPU has 1 core, which makes every CPU stage slower and the measured ratio larger: the two numbers are not from the same machine.
- Measured end-to-end, final design, same machine: 65.4x per steady epoch, 60.7x for the 5-epoch training including one-time costs (the model is 3.6x more FLOPs per image at 224 px and 2x the pixels at 320 px).
